account:
So far, I have no substantiated evidence of anything improper or unusual in town. During my morning market walk, I heard the neighbour say the builder was looking for the innkeeper and freight operator. The neighbour said the builder had business with them but had not explained what, and knew of no trouble. Several townsfolk repeated the same answer about not having seen them; that does not establish any separate knowledge of their business. I do not yet know what the builder wants from them. Ordinary work or freight arrangements are possible, but that is only a guess.

The neighbour pointed out the innkeeper near the town hall entrance shortly before eleven. I went into the hall to speak with them, but did not find them, and nobody was close enough to hear my greeting. A lantern was placed at (-58, -60, 32) around 10:36; I saw the change but not who placed it or why. I cannot connect that to the builder's business.

The secretary reports no correspondence, decisions requiring my attention, or substantiated unusual business from visitors. My appointment book is safely with the secretary. The neighbour expects me for our usual three o'clock tea at the dockside cottage, which will provide another opportunity to hear local news. I have spent the noon lunch appointment at home; it is now 12:52, and my next engagement is office accounts at thirteen. My feeling that something is happening without me remains a suspicion, not a discovery.
